cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to mop up after yourself. That wet sock beside your dinner came through the puddle you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you can study it while you eat. We clearly stopped the lesson before getting to other people's feet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please take it off the table. It's touching my plate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've noticed how unpleasant it is. I shouldn't have to supply the next two words for you; say them and I'll move it.

reason: Make A use the displayed inconvenience as a lesson the pupil has nearly understood, prompting apology rather than merely making a detached wet-atmosphere joke.
